arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Katyal argued ERISA allows plans to seek equitable relief to enforce terms.
Mr. Wessler argued subrogation claims are governed by equitable principles.
Mr. Palmore argued Section 502(a)(3) invokes the equitable powers of district courts.
